newsitem.title: USA: NRC fines Duquesne $160,000 for violations.
newsitem.headline: NRC fines Duquesne $160,000 for violations.

text.p: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday it fined Duquesne Light Co $160,000 for violations of NRC requirements at its Beaver Valley nuclear plant in Shippingport, Pa.
Four of the five violations stemmed from inadequate control over repairs last December to the head vent system in the 833 megawatt (MW) unit 2, the NRC said.

The fifth pertained to a failure to identify and correct for approximately 13 years the improper positioning of two isolation valves for power operated relief valves in the adjacent 810 MW unit 1, it said.
Duquesne has 30 days either to pay the proposed fine or request in writing that part or all of it be repealed.
Duquesne, subsidiary of DQE Inc, operates and holds partial stake in the two Beaver Valley nuclear units.
Ohio Edison and Centerior Energy Corp also have interests in both units.
